title: Scopebond session budgets (the session_budgets member of a workspace rules document)
description: Optional. Limits on what one coding-agent session may do: at most so many actions of the listed types (0 = none), until the budget expires. A workspace sends them in its rules document (type scopebond:managed-rules) as session_budgets, only to a hook that understands them; a hook that predates them ignores the member (the rules document check reads only the members it knows). Closed: an unknown key makes a budget invalid, and a hook that receives an invalid list refuses the whole rules document, so a malformed delivery never means no limit. The words follow the action-budget vocabulary of the gateway (budget_id, operations, max, mode, version, expires_at).

budget_id.description: Stable across versions of the same budget.

session_id.description: The opaque session id the hook signs into its receipts as context.session_id (never the coding tool's own session id).

mode.description: enforce: an action beyond a limit, or of a limited type once the budget expired, is denied. monitor: it is recorded as over and allowed.

expires_at.description: When the budget ends (two hours after it was approved by default). After it, an enforce budget denies the limited action types for that session.

source.description: Approved from a person's Ask an admin request, or set by an admin.

operations.description: The action types counted (for example file.write, git.push, package.install). A tool call counts once for a limit if any of its actions is one of these.

max.description: How many may be allowed in the session. 0: none.
